subject: How do I properly imbed an image URL in an HTML string

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: How do I properly imbed an image URL in an HTML string
parts:
I am trying to display 'help' at the push of a button.

In ui.R I have the following elements defined:

htmlOutput( "helpHTML" )
actionButton(  "helpButton", "Help" )

And then in server.R I have this code.

output$helpHTML <- renderUI({
    if ( trace.on ) print( "Entered showHelp: observer" )
    if ( input$helpButton == 0 ) return()
    HTML( readLines( "FinalReport.html" ) )
  })

This works just fine to display the html file (which is in the same directory where ui.R and server.R reside) except for one thing...

There is an imbedded graphic in the html referenced as follows...

<div align="left"><img src="FinalReportb4.PNG"  alt="graphic"></div>

This does not work because the url is translated to 

http://localhost:8100/FinalReportb2.PNG

when the html is rendered and as a result, the .png file cannot be found.

What should I be doing differently?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How do I properly imbed an image URL in an HTML string
parts: You could render FinalReport.html into a "www" subdirectory of your app directory, then it should work. Any images and other files in the www directory are automatically mapped to /filename.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: How do I properly imbed an image URL in an HTML string
parts:
You can always base64 encode the images; see
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_URI_scheme

There are a number of ways to do this in R. You may see
markdown:::.b64EncodeImages for an example (note ::: is usually a red
flag, so use with care).

For shiny, I think an easier way is to register a resource path
prefix, e.g. you can put your images under the images/ directory, and

addResourcePath('images', file.path(getwd(), 'images'))

Then http://localhost:8100/images/FinalReportb2.PNG will work.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: How do I properly imbed an image URL in an HTML string
parts:
Thanks.

I created a sub-directory titled www in my application directory, moved the FinalReport.html file and its associated .png files to that directory, then I changed...

output$helpHTML <- renderUI({
    if ( trace.on ) print( "Entered showHelp: observer" )
    if ( input$helpButton == 0 ) return()
    HTML( readLines( "FinalReport.html" ) )
  })

output$helpHTML <- renderUI({
    if ( trace.on ) print( "Entered showHelp: observer" )
    if ( input$helpButton == 0 ) return()

HTML( readLines( "www/FinalReport.html" ) )
  })

and all the image files appear as they should.

I vaguely remember references to such a www subdirectory in earlier conversations, but couldn't recall it when I needed it.  Others may have this problem, so I thought a detailed 'wrapup' would be in order.
